title: DeploymentOpsContract
description: Machine-readable deployment entrypoint contract: OpenTofu owns the Cloudflare edge, the cluster fleet is provisioned declaratively by Cluster API + Talos (installation-media zero-touch) + per-cell Argo CD, operators invoke tofu against infra/cloudflare (no root Makefile), day-2 changes route through ops, and no manual SSH troubleshooting.

_meta.amendment_note: v3.0.0: delete the root Makefile. Operator entry is tofu -chdir=infra/cloudflare plus cargo run -p marketplace-dev-cli -- gate validate deployment-ops-contract. Merge-path verify remains cargo (ADR-0716).
source_directives: no handrolling; declarative IaC. No root Makefile.
once setup, everything managed through ops/GitOps.
no manual ssh command troubleshooting. just works out of the box.
everything from control plane to worker auto-installs from installation media; cluster lifecycle via CAPI, apps via Argo CD.

deployment_authority.rationale: OpenTofu declarative state owns the Cloudflare edge (tunnel, DNS, Zero Trust Access). The Talos cluster fleet is provisioned by Cluster API (declared in git, reconciled by controllers) — see cluster_fleet below; it is not a tofu root.

roots.state_policy: root-declared backend; tunnel, DNS, and Zero Trust Access are OpenTofu-managed

cluster_fleet.model: Cluster API + Talos + Argo CD (ADR-0375; supersedes ADR-0120/0121)
cluster_fleet.node_install: Talos installation-media zero-touch (infra/talos/installation-media) — control-plane config baked offline, nodes fetch config
cluster_fleet.cluster_lifecycle: CAPI (infra/capi): clusterctl init + Talos/OCI/AWS/Metal3 providers; spoke Cluster CRs in infra/capi/clusters/
cluster_fleet.bootstrap_addons: CAPI ClusterResourceSet installs Cilium + Argo CD per cluster (infra/capi/crs)

talos_001_substrate_slice.note: Full TALOS-001 matrix, authority, claim_boundary, and path_conflict_policy content lives in the dedicated spec_ref file, enforced by the //ci/facade/contract-slice-conformance gate slice talos-001-substrate-slice.

cloudflare_edge.command_policy: Operators invoke tofu against infra/cloudflare only (Cloudflare edge) plus the Rust deployment-ops-contract gate. They must not embed ssh troubleshooting, oci compute mutation, or terraform CLI. Cluster-fleet bring-up is git/CAPI-driven. There is no root Makefile.

operator_entrypoints.contract_gate: cargo run -p marketplace-dev-cli -- gate validate deployment-ops-contract
allowed_human_commands_after_clone: cargo run -p marketplace-dev-cli -- gate validate deployment-ops-contract

bootstrap_contract.goal: Cold-start the deployment toolchain without bespoke runbooks.
minimum_behaviour: validate this deployment contract with Rust
verify tofu is installed and point to official OpenTofu install docs if absent
avoid networked package installation except OpenTofu/provider downloads requested by tofu init
non_goals: run component shell install scripts directly

install_contract.scope_note: `tofu apply` in infra/cloudflare provisions ONLY the OpenTofu-owned Cloudflare edge. It does NOT provision the cluster fleet — fleet bring-up is hardware-gated (boot Talos installation-media on real nodes) and multi-step. Treat fleet bring-up as a separate, manual/hardware-gated procedure until the cloud-ci fleet-bootstrap pipeline lands (registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#adr-0375-fleet-bootstrap-pipeline).
fleet_bring_up_separate: hardware-gated, NOT part of infra/cloudflare apply:
build Talos installation-media (infra/talos/installation-media/gen-media.sh) and boot it on the control-plane + node hardware
clusterctl init onto the formed control plane (infra/capi/init.sh)
add cells to infra/capi/clusters/values.yaml and helm template | kubectl apply — CAPI reconciles; per-cell Argo CD then owns app delivery
install_contract.confirmation_policy: OpenTofu apply prompts by default; do not use hidden auto-approve.

ops_management_contract.rule: After bootstrap/install, desired-state changes, drift repair, status, and incident workflows are initiated through ops, Argo CD, or repo-native Rust controllers, not ad hoc SSH sessions.
incident_flow: route fix through CI/CD hotfix PR, OpenTofu desired-state change, or Argo CD git change
do not page a human and do not manually SSH-troubleshoot

preconditions: active production safety incident where OpenTofu/CAPI/ops is unavailable
audit-chain row emitted before or immediately after action
follow-up PR restores declarative desired state
break_glass.normal_runbook: not present; break-glass is not a troubleshooting recipe

acceptance_criteria.rule: root Makefile must not exist; operators invoke tofu against infra/cloudflare
OpenTofu is the only deploy mutation authority for the Cloudflare edge; the cluster fleet is CAPI/Talos/Argo CD declared in git
manual SSH troubleshooting and OCI CLI mutation are explicitly forbidden
the deployment durable goal no longer routes incidents to page-on-call

TALOS-001 is represented as a non-mutating substrate slice matrix covering local vfkit/Talos smoke, Cloudflare Access tunnel posture, CAPI/Argo CD/Kamaji integration, and managed-Kubernetes product surface

verification_commands: cargo run -p marketplace-dev-cli -- gate validate deployment-ops-contract
